department: PhD School in Life Sciences (Faculties of Sciences and Medicine)

deadline.value: Two open calls a year close on April 1 and November 1. The Summer call starts in September (Autumn semester), so the April 1 deadline is the one for Fall 2027 entry; the year is not printed and is taken as 2027.
deadline.quote: There are two open calls per year. Call deadlines are April 1st and November 1st. | candidates from the Summer call usually start in September (Autumn semester)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Candidates are accepted only after a principal investigator makes an offer, so a supervisor's agreement comes before admission.
supervisor.quote: Only those candidates who have received an offer from a PI are officially accepted by the PhD School.

funding.value: Enrolled PhD students are fully funded by their host lab with a University of Geneva salary contract, and do not need their own funding.
funding.quote: Yes, as a PhD student in the program, you are fully funded by your host laboratory. | As a student in the PhD program, you do not need to secure your own funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a Master's degree or an equivalent degree; those with a different degree can request an equivalence review.
entry_route.quote: Applicants eligible for admission to the doctorate in life sciences are holders of a Master’s degree or a degree judged equivalent from an institution of higher education in Switzerland or abroad | Applicants holding a different degree are still encouraged to apply for this doctorate.

toefl_min.value: The school asks for B1 English and no test certificate at the online application stage, so no TOEFL minimum is set.
toefl_min.quote: You do not need to provide a certificate of English from an English language test (i.e. TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL) in your online application.

ielts_min.value: The school asks for B1 English and no test certificate at the online application stage, so no IELTS minimum is set.
ielts_min.quote: You do not need to provide a certificate of English from an English language test (i.e. TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL) in your online application.

english_waiver.value: The school requires B1 English (Regulations Art. 5.1 asks for an attestation) and does not name India or English-medium degrees.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants must also produce an attestation proving that they have the equivalent of a B1 competency level (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) in the English language

notes: Own application (open calls and ad hoc route). One school record covers six programmes: Molecular Biosciences, Ecology and Evolution, Genomics and Digital Health, Physics of Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences; saved under biology with biomed in also_fields. Physics of Biology is the school's interdisciplinary programme and is not the Physics Section PhD (see unige--physics). Fees: the FAQ sets a CHF 65 registration fee for foreign secondary-degree holders and CHF 500 semester fees, not an application fee. Deadline year: the page prints April 1 and November 1 without a year; the Winter Call 2026-27 (November 1, 2026) is for a Spring 2027 start. Pharmaceutical Sciences and Genomics pages were not mapped to Atlas fields.
name: PhD School in Life Sciences
